summary: The accepted mon.c change leaves the v43 case at the nemesis death boundary. C m_detach calls quest.c:nemdead, questpgr.c:stinky_nemesis, and conditionally quest.c:nemesis_stinks before relobj; JavaScript had only a note_unported stop at nemdead. The coherent fix also completes com_pager_core raw-text retrieval so the gas decision reads the same unconverted role text that qt_pager displayed.

source.branch: For a due-to-death MS_NEMESIS in mon.c:m_detach, nemdead marks killed_nemesis before qt_pager; stinky_nemesis fetches the same role-specific killed_nemesis text without output, normalizes newlines, and tests noxious/poisonous/toxic followed by gas/fumes; only a positive result runs nemesis_stinks, which sets mon_moving around create_gas_cloud(mx,my,5,8). Keep the m_detach order before relobj.
callers: mon.c:m_detach is called with due_to_death=true from mondead and false from mongone; only mondead enters the nemesis-death arm. m_detach orders nemdead -> stinky_nemesis -> conditional nemesis_stinks -> relobj.
